items.question: A service lift is descending but its downward speed is decreasing. Taking upward as positive, what direction must its net force point?

options.text: Upward, since its acceleration opposes its downward velocity.
Downward, because it is moving downward.
Zero, because the slowing is steady.
The direction cannot be inferred without its mass.

items.question: Two small robots pull against the ends of the same taut strap. Robot A pulls the strap left with 40 N. Which two forces make a Newton-third-law pair at A's connection to the strap?

options.text: A pulls the strap left with 40 N; gravity pulls A down.
A pulls the strap left with 40 N; the strap pulls B at its other end.
A pulls the strap left with 40 N; the strap pulls A right with 40 N.
The strap pulls A right with 40 N; gravity pulls A down.

source: final display choices, 001 ORIGINAL; 002 PU1 adapted from 455103ad
